parameters.query:
SELECT
  p.id,
  p.client_id,
  p.content,
  p.topic_pillar,
  p.post_format,
  p.approval_status,
  p.post_status,
  c.linkedin_email,
  c.linkedin_password,
  c.timezone
FROM posts p
JOIN clients c ON c.id = p.client_id
WHERE p.id = '{{ $json.post_id }}';

UPDATE posts SET
  approval_status = 'approved',
  post_status = 'draft',
  content = '{{ $json.content.replace(/\\/g, "\\\\").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  approved_at = NOW(),
  scheduled_for = {{ $json.scheduled_for ? `'${$json.scheduled_for}'` : 'NOW() + INTERVAL \'5 minutes\''}}
WHERE id = '{{ $json.post_id }}'
RETURNING id, client_id, content, approval_status, post_status, scheduled_for;

UPDATE posts SET
  approval_status = 'rejected',
  post_status = 'skipped',
  approval_note = '{{ ($json.rejection_reason || "Rejected by owner").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
WHERE id = '{{ $json.post_id }}'
RETURNING id, client_id, approval_status, post_status;
